Set 1
Set 2
With the team tasked with measuring the 
plants consistently every friday for expect 
during Thanksgiving break in which we made 
up for when we came back. During the 
experiment, worm casting and all-purpose 
fertilizer resulted in what seems to be best 
results. However, urea led to signiﬁcantly wider 
and larger plants both visually and in the 
measurements. In set 2, plants shriveled due to 
continuous 24/7 exposure and despite this, 
their growth rate was faster than set 1. Dr. 
Earth yielded poor results and dropped during 
week 6, with visible mold patches this maybe is 
because Dr. Earth has alot of organic matter.
In this season, we have gained insights into 
documenting an experiment by observing and 
carefully outlining our setups and procedures. 
Our surprising discovery is that we can grow 
plants using predominantly silicon dioxide or a 
sand-like material.
In the future, we aim to gather a wider 
range of data with increased variables 
and a unique setup. We plan to monitor 
the plants more closely, ideally 3 times a 
week, to ensure a more accurate 
outcome. This approach will allow us to 
better plan our setups and study our 
setup to minimize the risk that the 
plants might die.
